content.text: The insurance clause fully meets the playbook's preferred position.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 obliges Vendor (Copperleaf) at its own expense to carry each coverage the playbook requires at or above the preferred limits: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate; professional E&O USD 2M; cyber and privacy liability USD 5M (Vendor processes Customer Data under §15); and workers' compensation as required by law, plus employer's liability USD 1M as an extra. The term matches the preferred "throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter." Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, insurer quality, primary-coverage wording, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities — all customer-favourable. No edit is warranted; the notice-of-cancellation qualifier ("to the extent available from its insurer") is market-standard and not a playbook requirement.
